title: Riverside Garden: Outreach Options
subtitle: Which channels a volunteer team can run each week, what needs approval first, and what to leave for later.

ai.notes:
## Purpose

An example research report in the Helix 1.2 report style. All names, figures and links are invented.

## For the next AI

- Update the **Ranked options** only when the committee changes priorities.
- Keep **Hard limits** exactly as written.
- Every new claim needs a source with the date it was read; add it to **Sources**.

facts: Nothing was posted or signed up for
No costs are quoted, because none were verified

items.title: List every work day on community calendars
items.body:
Library, community centre and the town's events page. About 20 minutes per event.

**Committee provides:** dates, a short approved description, who may post.

items.title: One photo post a week
items.body:
A before-and-after or a harvest photo with one line of text and the next work day.

**Committee provides:** photos, approval of each post.

items.title: A sign at the gate with a sign-up link
items.body:
Weatherproof sign with the next work day and a short web address.

**Committee provides:** sign budget and wording.

items.title: Opt-in email list from work days
items.body:
A paper sign-up sheet that says exactly what people will receive. Monthly email only.

**Committee provides:** consent wording, who keeps the list.

items.title: School and youth group partnerships
items.body: A one-page invitation for teachers and group leaders. Introductions only, sent by a committee member.

items.title: Paid social ads: not now
items.body: Nothing to sell and no budget. Revisit after the first harvest festival.

blocks.title: Hard limits
blocks.text:
Never email anyone who did not opt in.
Never post photos of children without written permission from a parent or guardian.

blocks.title: Already working
blocks.text: The library calendar listings brought most of the new volunteers this season.
